source.title: The Varieties of Religious Experience: A Study in Human Nature
source.author: William James
source.license: Project Gutenberg; public domain in the USA. Full source notice retained in the raw text.

split: Source-order whole paragraphs; floor(0.8*N), floor(0.9*N). Split each assigned paragraph into sentence sequences afterward; no source paragraph spans subsets.
tokenization: NFC lowercase words and numbers; retain internal apostrophes/hyphens, alphanumeric codes and decimal numbers. Protect common abbreviations, initials/acronyms and decimals before heuristic .!? sentence splitting. Append EOS per sentence.
cleaning: Keep the twenty main lectures from the exact uppercase Lecture I heading to before POSTSCRIPT. Exclude preface, contents, postscript, index, endnotes and Gutenberg wrappers. Remove lecture headings, decorative separators and attached numeric footnote references. Keep quotations and numbered lists in the lectures. Join wrapped lines inside whole source paragraphs; normalize typographic hyphens.
